input.document_text: Warranty Service Request. Product: Whirlpool 215L Single Door Refrigerator (Model WDE 205 ROY). Customer: Kavitha Subramaniam. Purchase Date: 2024-07-12. Warranty Period: 2 years. Warranty End Date: 2026-07-12. Current Date of Claim: 2026-03-14. Days Remaining on Warranty: approximately 120 days. Issue: Refrigerator not maintaining temperature below 10°C. Technician Note: Cooling coil partially blocked with ice, likely defrost heater fault.
